units: <cite ref="Berakhot 32b:16">Ber. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>על כל חיל וחיל בראתי שלשים ר׳ ועל כל ר׳ ור׳ בראתי בו שלשים לגיון וכ׳</he> Ms. M. for each army (of stars in the signs of the Zodiac) I created thirty routes, and for each route I created in it (the sign) thirty legions &c., v. <cite ref="S01993"><he>קָרְטוֹן</he></cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 332">Yalk. Is. 332</cite> <cite ref="T00609"><he>רִיהֲ׳</he></cite>.
